thread:
Sam: Pulsar follow-up - their data science team patched Lumen-XL into a custom Alembic fork and want Private. Asks: tokenizer parity, KV cache semantics, Q4 quant path, and enterprise KMS. Can eng do a fast compat scan?
Iris: Need model bundle. Also confirm whether tokenizer adds BOS/EOS tokens + special padding. If they change token IDs we may need remap which can break prefix caching.
Liam: I can run a quick tokenizer diff and report vocab_size + sample encodings. If vocab_id mapping differs we can either remap at load or accept cache misses.
Iris: For quant path: we'll test Q4_0 and Q4_1 on a single V100 and post tok/sec numbers. If attention layout is standard, Q4 should work.
DevBot: Ticket created: DL-100412 for Pulsar Alembic compat. Assignee: Liam. https://projects.redwood.ai/DL-100412
Sam: Sales needs a short ops note + pricing delta (Dedicated vs Private) by Thu EOD. Can we aim for Wed morning results?
Liam: I'll run tokenizer + quick perf tonight and drop results in thread.
Iris: I'll assemble KMS checklist (key ARN, role, trust policy) and KV cache compatibility notes.
Sam: Thanks team :rocket:
